question: Related Questions Q. I am working postal department of india as postal assistant. in this department apart from mails.parcel,money order some other transactions of Savings Bank Viz.. In that case if i get an oppurtunity in the banks which offers me good salary by which i can save some money to go for heigher education. what should I do in this case please suggest? 5096 views Q. Ruling about the deposited money and old materials of customers after closing the workshop 1594 views Q. Is adding Google Adsense in a website, and earn money through this Halaal? Google Adsense is actually an Advertisement platform, which is embedded in a website, which shows different sort of advertisement. Though they say that they dont show porn type of ads as per their policy, but there are other non shariah advertisements to be displayed. Though all the ads are not Non Shariah, but if talking about the non shariah ads displayed by Google Adsense,l some are the advertisements of Dating, Songs, Meat, Skulls, Christianity Promition, Adult Hosting, " You must be saved to go to Heaven" etc. But as said, all the advertisement are not non shariah and haraam only. Halaal ads are also displayed there. Now please look into this matter, and let us know if the income of such earning is Halaal or not, and if not Halaal then what action could be taken on that.. If the income coming from, is like 100,000 USD per month. 12484 views Q. کیا کرکٹ دیکھنا جائزہے؟ 8155 views Q. کیا پاسپورٹ سائز فوٹو کھینچنا جائز ہے مسلمانوں کے لیے ؟ 1325 views Q. I need guidence regarding a person whom i had visited for cure of jinn,black magic etc who treats all sorts of black magic, jins etc & he is a well known Alim,how do i identify if he is doing according to shariah or not or if it is any sort of shirk? 2928 views Q. Asalamu alaykum. I am an American Convert. Have been muslim for 1 year and 5 months now. I am currently talking to a man from Egypt regarding engagement/marriage. He's going about it the proper way by talking to my guardian (since my father is not muslim) and his parents have agreed. But now I have a big problem. I understand in Islam that women and men shouldn't talk more than business. He asked me to delete the friends from my internet accounts who I didn't even talk to. Out of respect for him and because I knew that I would need to for marriage anyway I did this. But now he still has sisters who he works with or who are students that he advises on his account. He got angry with me when I asked him if he could do the same and delete them. He said that in Egypt men are allowed to but women can't (which is impossible anyway). Is this simply a cultural issue or is there some proof in Quran and Sunnah. I know it's hard because it's over the internet, but what can I do? Is it right for him to keep his female aqaintances when I can't? I've told him my feelings and I don't like it. Another problem I have is that I can't usually read what these women comment on his profile either as it's in Arabic and I speak very little. Please help. 2239 views Q. custom 1397 views Q. تعلیم قرآن اور تفسیر پڑھانے پر اجرت لینا 1651 views Q. Halal and Haram 2750 views Q. I just want to ask in which condition it is halal to buy a product on EMI or anybody can buy it. Please answer. 3528 views Q. We put company?s money in bank current account instead of savings account because bank own consumes interest from current account But customer consumes it from savings account. If I interest to put my money in savings account & collect the interest to distribute to the poor, (without the aim to get virtue). Will it be right or appropriate according to Muslim Sari-ah ? Request to explain the matter vast. 2217 views Q. Is Receiving Leave Salary Without Work Permissible? 2014 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 36218 Country: India Title: Is it right to give my land or building on rent to banks or any other financial organizations whose dealings are based on interest partially or completely. Question: Is it right to give my land or building on rent to banks or any other financial organizations whose dealings are based on interest partially or completely. Answer ID: 36218 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 206/206/M=1433) It is better not to give as it is helping in sin. وقالا : لا ينبغي ذلك لأنه إعانة على المعصية وبه قالت الثلاثة (شامى زكريا 9/563) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
